thread:
maria-sales: Hey team — HelixPay just sent a SIG/CAIQ (attached). It's for a major POC; they want answers by EOD Fri. Private deployment + KMS + SOC2 reqs. Can someone own? :eyes:

devin-se: Can you drop the doc link? Also which sections are they flagging as blockers?

maria-sales: Link: https://files.redwood/helixpay/sig_2026-03-20.pdf
They highlighted key items: KMS/HSM, pen test recency, network segmentation, access reviews, and third-party subprocessor list.

ashley-security: I can take ownership for the controls review. ETA? Fri EOD is tight given volume; can we buy 48 hours? :thinking: 

maria-sales: Client expects firm EOD Fri — they're starting procurement review then. Can we at least send a partial with critical controls (KMS, SOC2, pen test) and mark the rest as "under review"?

ashley-security: Yes. I'll prepare a partial set: KMS/HSM answer, SOC2 link, latest pen test summary, and notes on private deployment. Need pointer to certs and pen-test report location.

devin-se: For the KMS bit, we should clarify support for customer-managed keys in Private; say "supported via KMS integration (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, HSM via bring-your-own-HSM) — details in private-deploy runbook". Use that wording.

raj-legal: Also flag the subprocessor list — legal wants the latest list attached. Maria, can you confirm HelixPay's data residency needs? They mentioned EU-only earlier.

maria-sales: Confirmed: EU-only. POC will be in eu-west-1. Please note in answers.

ashley-security: Noted. I'll call out region-specific key handling and that key material can be region-bound with customer's KMS.

maria-sales: Created a ticket in #sig-queue: https://redwood/issue/RE-4821

sig-bot: New SIG intake created: RE-4821 — assigned to ashley-security (auto-assign). Due date: 2026-03-22. :white_check_mark:

ashley-security: Taking it. I'll post the partial answers in the ticket and paste back here. Will also add the SOC2 report link.

devin-se: If you need any config snippets for private deploy KMS config, ping me. I have sample env + terraform snippet.

maria-sales: Thanks. Client asked about pen-test scope — internal vs. external. Ashley, can you include whether our pen test covers external network + application layer?

ashley-security: Yes — our latest pen test covers external perimeter and app layer; will include summary and remediation status.

maria-sales: Awesome. If we can get partial out by tomorrow morning their procurement team will unblock the legal review.

devin-se: tagging @ops-team — we'll need a quick runbook excerpt on key rotation and log access for HelixPay.

ops-oncall: @devin-se noted. I'll prep a 1-pager and attach to RE-4821.

ashley-security: Quick note — two possible blockers: 1) They require independent pen test report (not summary) — procurement might want full report under NDA. 2) They asked about HSM certs for BYO-HSM; UX needs vendor certs.

maria-sales: OK, I'll check with HelixPay if an NDA is acceptable for the full report and ask for vendor names for HSM.

devin-se: I'll draft the temporary wording for any unanswered questions: "Under review — will provide within 48 hours" so procurement has something.

maria-sales: Perfect. Thread will be linked to RE-4821. Keep me posted. :pray:
